connector.name: gitea-mcp
connector.registryDescription: Model Context Protocol server for Gitea (and Forgejo, Codeberg).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gitea-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the werebear73 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITEA_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Gitea/Forgejo/Codeberg instance

env.name: GITEA_TOKEN
env.description: Personal access token for the configured instance

env.name: GITEA_RETRY_BASE_DELAY
env.description: Retry backoff base delay in seconds
